page.layout: One printed page, one text column; small marginal marks at the right edge of the column (a few dots/ticks near the Cap. 4 heading) are not readable as notes. Running head at top centre; page number top right.

main_text.p: Arrian.lib.5,Μεγαδένης τε ὴ Ἐρατοσθένης δοκίμω ἀνδρε ξυγγραφάτω, Megasthenesq; & Eratosthenes,duo probati viri,conscripserunt. Hîc duo singularia conveniunt duali.
Anomalia tamen frequens illa est. Isocr. δύο ἔποι τυγχάνοισιν, duo modi sunt. Hîc dualis & pluralis conjunguntur. Sic Aristot. κατηγορικῶν μὴ ὄντων ἀμφοῖν, affirmativa cúm sint ambo. Et sic alia.
main_text.head: Cap. 4. De anomalia generis.
main_text.p: Anomalia generis est illa licentior. Homerus:
main_text.l: δῶςν Ϝοί ἐγὼ τέκνον φίλε τῦτο δίδωμί,

l.i: Donum tibi etiâ ego,fili chare,hoc do.

page.notes: Greek line "Arrian" and "Isocr." passages copied as legible; some Greek accents uncertain. Faint ink marks at lower centre are stains, not text. Headword "Anomalia" line 1 of the Cap. 4 heading may carry a dropped-letter mark.
